pages.quiz:
GEOGRAPHY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Nairobi
   C. Kisumu
   D. Mombasa

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

3. Which statement about Vulcanicity is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Vulcanicity with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Vulcanicity as rumours only.
   C. Say Vulcanicity never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Vulcanicity.

4. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   C. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.

5. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Name the president
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

6. Which statement about Mining is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Mining as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Mining.
   C. Say Mining never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Mining with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about Industry is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Industry with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Industry never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Industry.
   D. Treat Industry as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Earthquakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Earthquakes.
   B. Treat Earthquakes as rumours only.
   C. Say Earthquakes never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Earthquakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Avoiding all community work

10. Which statement about Energy is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Energy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Energy.
   C. Say Energy never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Energy as rumours only.

11. Which statement about Introduction to Geography is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Introduction to Geography with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Introduction to Geography as rumours only.
   C. Say Introduction to Geography never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Geography.

12. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Statistical Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Geographic Information Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Rocks and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Folding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

9. C — Obeying laws and caring for public property

11. A — Explain Introduction to Geography with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. B — Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

14. (4 marks)

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Rocks; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
